name: the_great_mount_of_ghaethluntar
title: The Great Mount of Ghaethluntar
description: A massive mountain in the extreme [[north Faerûn]], inhabited by [[gnoll]] miners who sent caravans down the [[Remorhaz Ride]] through the icy tundra, hauling 40 to 60 ore-laden sleds at a time from [[Mount Ghaethluntar]] to [[Frozen Flindyke]].
